name: Special City Council Meeting
minutes_text:
MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council Special Meeting

  July 22, 2013

A Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to
order by Mayor Reardon at 5:03 p.m., on July 22, 2013, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo,
California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on July 18, 2013, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall, 200 Civic Center.
Copies were also posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso
Drive, and at the Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

Present:  Council Member Leckness
  Council Member Schlicht
  Council Member Ury (arrived at 5:08 p.m.)
  Mayor Pro Tem Kelley
  Mayor Reardon

Absent:  None

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk/Director of Community Relations

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Reardon

INVOCATION: Mayor Pro Tem Kelley

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Gregory Raths, M.V.: announced that he will be running for California’s 45th Congressional
District seat in the 2014 election.

OLD BUSINESS

1.  School Crossing Guard Services

  Mark Chagnon, Director of Public Works, presented the staff report.

City Council Minutes  1  July 22, 2013
   Roger Flores, Director of Operations, and Adolfo Avendano, Regional Manager, American
  Guard Services, Inc., Carson: discussed their company’s history and qualifications. Stated
  that they intend to make the transition very smooth and they plan to hire as many of the
  current crossing guards as possible and to station them at the same schools/locations.

  Motion made by Mayor Pro Tem Kelley, seconded by Council Member Ury, to (1) award
  the contract in the amount of $538,314 to American Guard Services, Inc. (A13-35) for
  school crossing guard services for the period July 1, 2013, to June 30, 2015; and (2)
  authorize issuance of a purchase order to American Guard Services, Inc., in an amount not
  to exceed $269,157 for the period July 1, 2013, to June 30, 2014.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Reardon, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

2.  Contract to Host the 2013 International Tennis Federation (ITF) Wheelchair Singles
  Masters

  City Manager Dennis Wilberg presented the report.

  Motion made by Council Member Ury, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Kelley, to authorize
  staff to enter into a contract (A13-36) with the ITF to host the 2013 Wheelchair Singles
  Masters at the Marguerite Tennis Pavilion November 5 – 11, 2013.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Reardon, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 5:25 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this session,
Mayor Reardon adjourned the meeting to Monday, August 19, 2013, at 5:00 p.m.

__________________________________________________
Karen Hamman, City Clerk/Director of Community Relations

Approved at the meeting of August 19, 2013

City Council Minutes  2  July 22, 2013
